title.narrative: Technical Assistance and Surge Support - Resilience and Emergency Response

description.narrative: This activity Technical Assistance and Surge Support - Resilience and Emergency Response is a component of Building Resilience and an Effective Emergency Refugee Response (BRAER) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £799,568. It works in the following sector(s): Facilitation of orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility, Immediate post-emergency reconstruction and rehabilitation.
